python3 - << 'PY'
# Extract the data from the bulletins
# Department of Energy (column 7) and Department of Agriculture (column 3)

# From treasury_bulletin_2016_12_page_21.txt
data_2012 = {'energy': 32485, 'agriculture': 139712}

data_2016 = {'energy': 25852, 'agriculture': 138161}
data_2017 = {'energy': 25794, 'agriculture': 127563}

# From treasury_bulletin_2020_12_page_24.txt
data_2018 = {'energy': 26479, 'agriculture': 136713}
data_2019 = {'energy': 28936, 'agriculture': 150120}

# Create series
energy = [data_2012['energy'], data_2013['energy'], data_2014['energy'], 
          data_2015['energy'], data_2016['energy'], data_2017['energy'],
          data_2018['energy'], data_2019['energy']]

agriculture = [data_2012['agriculture'], data_2013['agriculture'], data_2014['agriculture'],
               data_2015['agriculture'], data_2016['agriculture'], data_2017['agriculture'],
               data_2018['agriculture'], data_2019['agriculture']]

print("Energy outlays (millions):", energy)
print("Agriculture outlays (millions):", agriculture)

# Tukey exclusive median hinge method for Q3
# Split data at median, then find median of upper half
def tukey_exclusive_q3(data):
    sorted_data = sorted(data)
    n = len(sorted_data)
    # Find median
    if n % 2 == 0:
        median = (sorted_data[n//2 - 1] + sorted_data[n//2]) / 2
        # Split into halves - lower half is indices 0 to n/2-1, upper half is n/2 to n-1
        lower_half = sorted_data[:n//2]
        upper_half = sorted_data[n//2:]
    else:
        median = sorted_data[n//2]
        # Exclude median when splitting
        lower_half = sorted_data[:n//2]
        upper_half = sorted_data[n//2+1:]
    
    # Q3 is median of upper half
    m = len(upper_half)
    if m % 2 == 0:
        q3 = (upper_half[m//2 - 1] + upper_half[m//2]) / 2
    else:
        q3 = upper_half[m//2]
    
    return q3

energy_q3 = tukey_exclusive_q3(energy)
agriculture_q3 = tukey_exclusive_q3(agriculture)

print(f"\nEnergy Q3 (Tukey exclusive): {energy_q3}")
print(f"Agriculture Q3 (Tukey exclusive): {agriculture_q3}")

difference = energy_q3 - agriculture_q3
print(f"Difference (Energy Q3 - Agriculture Q3): {difference}")
PY
